responsibility: This installed private header centralizes the fundamental AArch64 AdvSIMD/NEON typedefs that are shared by `arm_neon.h`, `arm_sve.h`, and `arm_sme.h`. It maps GCC’s internal vector builtin types to the public ACLE scalar, vector, polynomial, bfloat16, and mfloat8 type names, providing the stable type-definition layer on which the public intrinsic headers and pragma-generated declarations rely.
